info.title: Waste Volume Estimation API
info.description:
## Waste Volume Estimation API

REST API for CCTV-based waste volume estimation using computer vision pipeline:
- **Calibration**: Camera calibration from chessboard images
- **Ground Reference**: Ground plane reference points for metric mapping
- **Segmentation**: YOLO-seg waste detection (Sampah_Berserakan, Sampah_Overload)
- **Depth Estimation**: Monocular depth estimation (YOLO depth)
- **3D Lifting**: Lift waste pixels to 3D ground coordinates
- **Volume Estimation**: Grid-based and convex hull volume calculation
- **BEV Projection**: Bird's Eye View visualization

### Authentication
All endpoints require an API key via the `X-API-Key` header.
Configure valid keys via `VALID_API_KEYS` environment variable.

### Scopes
- `camera:read` / `camera:write` - Camera management
- `calibration:read` / `calibration:write` - Calibration
- `ground_ref:read` / `ground_ref:write` - Ground references
- `predict:read` / `predict:write` - Predictions

### Versioning
Calibrations and ground references are versioned per camera. Only one version can be active at a time.
